ALTER VIEW [DW].[ViewRBBLoanAccount]
AS

WITH BusinessDate AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
MIN(BusinessDateSK) As BusinessDateSk
FROM (
    SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) BusinessDateSk FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure FLRE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSk) BusinessDateSk FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance FLOB

) a )

SELECT DISTINCT
BD.BusinessdateSK AS BusinessDateSk
,DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DCA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DCA.AccountID AS AccountID
,DDA.AccountName AS AccountName
,DDAH.AccountHolderTypeName AS AccountHolderType
,DDA.AccountStatus AS AccountStatus
,DDA.ProfitCostCode AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BranchName AS BranchName  
,DDB.Area AS Area
,DDB.Region AS Region
,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName AS ProductName
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureFull_Original
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureProrated_Original
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureCurrency_Original
,NULL AS RelationshipExposureCurrency_Target
,NULL AS RelationshipExposurePesoConversionRate
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull AS RelationshipExposureFull 
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated AS RelationshipExposureShared
,NULL AS AmortizationAmount_Original
,NULL AS InterestAmount_Original
,NULL AS PenaltyAmount_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthFull_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthProrated_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthCurrency_Original
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthCurrency_Target
,NULL AS DueForTheMonthPesoConversionRate 
,FLOB.AmortizationAmount AS AmortizationAmount
,FLOB.InterestAmount AS InterestAmount
,FLOB.PenaltyAmount AS PenaltyAmount
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull AS DueForTheMonthFull
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated AS DueForTheMonthShared
,NULL AS CreditLimitFull_Original
,NULL AS CreditLimitProrated_Original
,NULL AS CreditLimitCurrency_Original
,NULL AS CreditLimitCurrency_Target
,NULL AS CreditLimitPesoConversionRate
,NULL AS CreditLimitFull
,NULL AS CreditLimitShared
FROM  DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountName,AccountStatus,ProfitCostCode,AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS')  DDA ON DCA.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountHolderTypeName, AccountHolderTypeSk FROM DW.DimAccountHolderType --WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
) DDAH ON DCA.AccountHolderTypeSK = DDAH.AccountHolderTypeSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchName,Area,Region,BranchSk FROM DW.DimBranch WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DDB ON DCA.BranchSk = DDB.BranchSk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK, ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS') DDAP ON DCA.AccountSk = DDAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup, ProductName, ProductSk FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DP ON DDAP.ProductSk = DP.ProductSk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BusinessDateSK,AccountSk,TotalRelationshipExposureFull,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure) FLRE ON  DCA.AccountSk = FLRE.Accountsk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BusinessDateSK,AmortizationAmount,InterestAmount,PenaltyAmount,OutstandingBalanceFull,OutstandingBalanceProrated,AccountSk FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance) FLOB ON  DCA.AccountSK = FLOB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN BusinessDate BD ON FLRE.BusinessDateSK = BD.BusinessDateSK AND FLOB.BusinessDateSK = BD.BusinessDateSK
WHERE BD.BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 

GO
